prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Transparent cutout photographic 3D satin ribbon for event invitation website.
Primary request: One long single rich oxblood burgundy satin ribbon folding and curling through two generous sweeping bends in a horizontal S curve. Three-quarter perspective. Left tip narrow and tapered; the right sweep forms a wide open loop. Rich dimensional folds, believable thickness at folded edges, flowing but physically plausible.
Composition/framing: Wide horizontal object centered with generous transparent margin. The complete ribbon including both tips fits fully inside the frame. It should function as a floating foreground overlay on both cool powder blue and wine surfaces.
Lighting/mood: Soft directional studio photography with restrained glossy reflections. Dark wine folds, brighter burgundy satin planes, subtle pale citron edge highlight on lit edges to separate the object on a dark wine background.
Color palette: Oxblood burgundy satin, naturally dark wine folds, restrained warm pale citron edge highlight.
Materials/textures: Fine smooth satin weave with realistic glossy softness, no metallic chrome.
Constraints: Real transparent alpha background, no ground, backdrop or cast shadow outside the ribbon, all spaces and holes between folds transparent. No text, logos, watermark, rings, chrome, confetti, particles or other objects.
Avoid: rectangular matte fragments, white fringe, black fringe, flat vector appearance, neon, rainbow, cropped ends, tangled knots, many small messy folds.
